note: Three in-process models, each with one planted secret. The pin-tumbler model has four pins, binding order 2, 0, 3, 1, and cuts 3-1-5-0. The wafer model has three wafers, order 0, 2, 1, and lifts 1-3-2. The keypad model plants 7395. Each picker reads only yes or no answers from its model. This opens only the simulated lock inside the test, not a real lock. Not a procedure for a physical lock and not a claim about Nr. 86.
